propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific maintainer bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of prescribing the committer's own configured git identity for DCO sign-off.

Multiple documentation files (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, CONTRIBUTING.md) contain contradictory or bot-specific sign-off instructions that conflict with the policy requiring real contributor names.

Guidance must be updated to instruct contributors to use their configured git identity (git config user.name/user.email) and the bot identity must be retained only in automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/).
A deterministic lint-integrated consistency check must be implemented to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-offs in contributor-facing documentation.
